p0036_1.t: Summary Table: Land, Population, Cultivated Land and Agriculture

p0041_3.d: Gives the area (hectares) of fixed-term (leased) land in Hokkaidō by year, divided into paddy, upland, building land, forest, pasture, wilderness, miscellaneous land and others.

p0045_1.d: Gives households (ordinary and quasi-households) and population by sex for each region of Japan Proper at the censuses of 1 October 1925 and 1920, with five-year increase, persons per household, density and sex ratio.

p0054_1.t: Number of Cities, Towns and Villages and Population

p0054_2.t: Households and Population of the Cities
